item.title: Global AI sell-off turns into India's gain as FPIs pump ₹46,000 crore in 5 sessions; will the buying spree sustain?
item.description: Foreign investors poured ₹45,970 crore into Indian equities in November, helping the Nifty 50 post its strongest weekly gain since February 2021 and lifting the rupee. Lower oil prices, resilient earnings and a retreat from AI-linked stocks helped make India more attractive.

item.title: Why did RR Kabel share rally 8% during Muhurat Trading despite weak market sentiment — what triggered the surge?
item.description: RR Kabel shares rose 8% to ₹2,073 during Sunday’s Muhurat Trading session, helped by unusually high volumes despite broader market losses. The stock had recently weakened after subdued FY27 growth guidance, although September-quarter profit increased 55.7% and revenue rose 51.8% year on year.

item.title: Why Safe Enterprises shares bleeding on Diwali Muhurat trading 2026 session despite Nifty, Sensex in green? Key reasons
